{"untrusted_files_with_line_numbers": {"SKILL.md": "1: ---
2: name: web-fetch
3: description: Fetches web content as clean markdown by preferring markdown-native responses and falling back to selector-based HTML extraction. Use for documentation, articles, and reference pages at http/https URLs.
4: ---
5: 
6: # Web Content Fetching
7: 
8: Fetch web content in this order:
9: 1. Prefer markdown-native endpoints (`content-type: text/markdown`)
10: 2. Use selector-based HTML extraction for known sites
11: 3. Use the bundled Bun fallback script when selectors fail
12: 
13: ## Prerequisites
14: 
15: Verify required tools before extracting:
16: 
17: ```bash
18: command -v curl >/dev/null || echo "curl is required"
19: command -v html2markdown >/dev/null || echo "html2markdown is required for HTML extraction"
20: command -v bun >/dev/null || echo "bun is required for fetch.ts fallback"
21: ```
22: 
23: Install Bun dependencies for the bundled script:
24: 
25: ```bash
26: cd ~/.claude/skills/web-fetch && bun install
27: ```
28: 
29: ## Default Workflow
30: 
31: Use this as the default flow for any URL:
32: 
33: ```bash
34: URL="<url>"
35: CONTENT_TYPE="$(curl -sIL "$URL" | awk -F': ' 'tolower($1)=="content-type"{print tolower($2)}' | tr -d '\r' | tail -1)"
36: 
37: if echo "$CONTENT_TYPE" | grep -q "markdown"; then
38:   curl -sL "$URL"
39: else
40:   curl -sL "$URL" \
41:     | html2markdown \
42:         --include-selector "article,main,[role=main]" \
43:         --exclude-selector "nav,header,footer,script,style"
44: fi
45: ```
46: 
47: ## Known Site Selectors
48: 
49: | Site | Include Selector | Exclude Selector |
50: |------|------------------|------------------|
51: | platform.claude.com | `#content-container` | - |
52: | docs.anthropic.com | `#content-container` | - |
53: | developer.mozilla.org | `article` | - |
54: | github.com (docs) | `article` | `nav,.sidebar` |
55: | Generic | `article,main,[role=main]` | `nav,header,footer,script,style` |
56: 
57: Example:
58: 
59: ```bash
60: curl -sL "<url>" \
61:   | html2markdown \
62:       --include-selector "#content-container" \
63:       --exclude-selector "nav,header,footer"
64: ```
65: 
66: ## Finding the Right Selector
67: 
68: When a site isn't in the patterns list:
69: 
70: ```bash
71: # Check what content containers exist
72: curl -s "<url>" | grep -o '<article[^>]*>\|<main[^>]*>\|id="[^"]*content[^"]*"' | head -10
73: 
74: # Test a selector
75: curl -sL "<url>" | html2markdown --include-selector "<selector>" | head -30
76: 
77: # Check line count
78: curl -sL "<url>" | html2markdown --include-selector "<selector>" | wc -l
79: ```
80: 
81: ## Universal Fallback Script
82: 
83: When selectors produce poor output, run the bundled parser:
84: 
85: ```bash
86: bun ~/.claude/skills/web-fetch/fetch.ts "<url>"
87: ```
88: 
89: If already in the skill directory:
90: 
91: ```bash
92: bun fetch.ts "<url>"
93: ```
94: 
95: ## Options Reference
96: 
97: ```bash
98: --include-selector "CSS"  # Keep only matching elements
99: --exclude-selector "CSS"  # Remove matching elements
100: --domain "https://..."    # Convert relative links to absolute
101: ```
102: 
103: ## Troubleshooting
104: 
105: **Empty output with selectors**: The page might be markdown-native. Check headers first:
106: 
107: ```bash
108: curl -sIL "<url>" | grep -i '^content-type:'
109: ```
110: 
111: **Wrong content selected**: The site may have multiple article/main regions:
112: 
113: ```bash
114: curl -s "<url>" | grep -o '<article[^>]*>'
115: ```
116: 
117: **`html2markdown` not found**: Install it, then retry selector-based extraction.
118: 
119: **`bun` or script deps missing**: Run `cd ~/.claude/skills/web-fetch && bun install`.
120: 
121: **Missing code blocks**: Check if the site uses non-standard code formatting.
122: 
123: **Client-rendered content**: If HTML only has "Loading..." placeholders, the content is JS-rendered. Neither curl nor the Bun script can extract it; use browser-based tools.", "fetch.ts": "1: import { parseHTML } from "linkedom";
2: import TurndownService from "turndown";
3: 
4: const url = process.argv[2];
5: if (!url) {
6:   console.error("Usage: bun fetch.ts <url>");
7:   process.exit(1);
8: }
9: 
10: // Step 1: Fetch
11: const response = await fetch(url, {
12:   headers: {
13:     "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; ClaudeCode/1.0)",
14:   },
15: });
16: 
17: if (!response.ok) {
18:   console.error(`Fetch failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
19:   process.exit(1);
20: }
21: 
22: const html = await response.text();
23: 
24: // Step 2: Parse DOM
25: const { document } = parseHTML(html);
26: 
27: // Step 3: Find the content-rich element
28: const candidates = [
29:   ...document.querySelectorAll("article"),
30:   ...document.querySelectorAll("main"),
31:   ...document.querySelectorAll('[role="main"]'),
32:   ...document.querySelectorAll(".content"),
33:   ...document.querySelectorAll("#content"),
34: ];
35: 
36: let contentEl: Element | null = null;
37: let maxLength = 0;
38: 
39: for (const el of candidates) {
40:   const len = el.textContent?.length || 0;
41:   if (len > maxLength) {
42:     maxLength = len;
43:     contentEl = el;
44:   }
45: }
46: 
47: if (!contentEl) {
48:   contentEl = document.body;
49: }
50: 
51: // Step 4: Clean up the content element before conversion
52: // Remove navigation elements
53: const removeSelectors = [
54:   "nav",
55:   "header",
56:   "footer",
57:   "script",
58:   "style",
59:   "noscript",
60:   '[role="navigation"]',
61:   ".sidebar",
62:   ".nav",
63:   ".menu",
64:   ".toc",
65:   '[aria-label="breadcrumb"]',
66: ];
67: 
68: for (const selector of removeSelectors) {
69:   contentEl.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach((el) => el.remove());
70: }
71: 
72: // Step 5: Convert to Markdown with Turndown
73: const turndown = new TurndownService({
74:   headingStyle: "atx",
75:   codeBlockStyle: "fenced",
76: });
77: 
78: // Better code block handling
79: turndown.addRule("fencedCodeBlock", {
80:   filter: (node) => {
81:     return (
82:       node.nodeName === "PRE" &&
83:       node.firstChild &&
84:       node.firstChild.nodeName === "CODE"
85:     );
86:   },
87:   replacement: (content, node) => {
88:     const el = node as Element;
89:     const code = el.querySelector("code");
90:     const className = code?.className || "";
91:     const lang = className.match(/language-(\w+)/)?.[1] || "";
92:     const text = code?.textContent || "";
93:     return `\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${text}\n\`\`\`\n`;
94:   },
95: });
96: 
97: // Handle pre without code child
98: turndown.addRule("preBlock", {
99:   filter: (node) => {
100:     return (
101:       node.nodeName === "PRE" &&
102:       (!node.firstChild || node.firstChild.nodeName !== "CODE")
103:     );
104:   },
105:   replacement: (content, node) => {
106:     const text = (node as Element).textContent || "";
107:     return `\n\`\`\`\n${text}\n\`\`\`\n`;
108:   },
109: });
110: 
111: // Remove "Copy page" buttons and similar UI elements
112: turndown.addRule("removeButtons", {
113:   filter: (node) => {
114:     if (node.nodeName === "BUTTON") return true;
115:     const el = node as Element;
116:     if (el.getAttribute?.("aria-label")?.includes("Copy")) return true;
117:     return false;
118:   },
119:   replacement: () => "",
120: });
121: 
122: const markdown = turndown.turndown(contentEl.innerHTML);
123: 
124: // Step 6: Clean up the output
125: const cleaned = markdown
126:   // Remove Loading... placeholders
127:   .replace(/^Loading\.\.\.$/gm, "")
128:   // Remove Copy buttons
129:   .replace(/^Copy page$/gm, "")
130:   .replace(/^Copy$/gm, "")
131:   // Fix empty headings (## \n\nActual heading -> ## Actual heading)
132:   .replace(/^(#{1,6})\s*\n\n+([A-Z])/gm, "$1 $2")
133:   // Remove completely empty headings
134:   .replace(/^#{1,6}\s*$/gm, "")
135:   // Collapse multiple newlines
136:   .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
137:   .trim();
138: 
139: // Output with title
140: const title = document.title || "Untitled";
141: console.log(`# ${title}\n`);
142: console.log(cleaned);"}}
